Honey has been drizzled over thin crepes to bring out their natural sweetness and flavor.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Honey Crepes are dishes made by [[Cooking]] [[Fresh Milk]], a [[Bird Egg]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Cane Sugar]], and [[Courser Bee Honey]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. They can be eaten to refill two fifths of [[Link]]'s [[Stamina Wheel]] and restore ten [[Heart]]s of his [[Life Gauge]]. The [[Courser Bee Honey]] drizzled over them brings out their natural sweetness and flavor. Since five ingredients are necessary to make [[Energizing Honey Crepe|Honey Crepes]], only their energizing version can be made. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Honey Crepes return in {{TotK}} with an identical [[Recipe]]. They can be made in either a [[Cooking Pot]] or a [[Portable Pot]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Honey Crepes appear in {{AoC}} as an unlockable [[Recipe]]. The Recipe is unlocked after completing the [[Scenario]] "[[The Great Plateau]]". Like in {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, they are made with [[Cane Sugar]], a [[Bird Egg]], [[Courser Bee Honey]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], and [[Fresh Milk]]. If made, [[Warrior]]s will earn 30% more [[Rupee]]s in the battle. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Honey Crepe Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Energizing Honey Crepe icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Plain Crepe * Wildberry Crepe }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Desserts, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
